# ClinicalTrials.gov

> > ClinicalTrials.gov is the U.S. government's registry of clinical studies, providing public access to trial information and a registration system for researchers to submit protocols and results.

Operated by the U.S. National Library of Medicine at the National Institutes of Health, ClinicalTrials.gov serves as the authoritative database for clinical trial registration and results reporting. The Protocol Registration and Results System (PRS) enables researchers and study sponsors to register trials and submit study results in compliance with federal regulations.

- Protocol Registration and Results System (PRS)
- Clinical trial registration
